subject: social-studies

modelAuthority.note: The nine Social Studies R2 samples are the frozen model. They are read-only inputs to R3 and are never edited, moved, or re-statused by promotion.

contract.rule: A complete R3 production lesson satisfies the model schema AND the production envelope schema AND the ordered rhythm rule below. The frozen R2 samples satisfy the model schema only; that difference is the promotion gate.

rhythm.model: QUESTION/CONTEXT -> BACKGROUND -> EVIDENCE -> MODEL THINKING -> YOUR TURN -> FEEDBACK -> REVIEW
rhythm.note: Ordered rule. Sections must appear in this order; evidence steps admit more than one section. Verified to hold for all nine frozen R2 samples.

orderedRule.label: Readable evidence for the worked example
Labeled EXAMPLE with complete modeled reasoning
orderedRule.humanReviewNote: The automated check proves the modeled prompt is not a copy of the learner's own prompts. Whether the modeled case is genuinely a different case, clause, dataset, or network stays a human review judgment.

orderedRule.label: Fresh independent response with less support

preconditions.statement: The lesson validates against the model schema with no violations.
The lesson satisfies rhythm.orderedRule in order.
lessonRef, title, and standards reproduce the canonical student-work package at canonicalLessonPath exactly. The canonical package is a read-only mapping authority.
Every responseKind is one of the existing LearnerResponseRuntime types. No new response type is introduced.
createRichLessonRenderModel returns mode 'rich' and no legacy fallback is required.
Every authored sectionKind classifies into the canonical RichLessonSectionKind union through classifyRichLessonSection. The authored vocabulary never outruns what the player can render.
No key anywhere in the lesson names an answer, correctness flag, solution, score, scoring rule, or rubric answer. Correctness is a trusted-assessment decision.
preconditions.patternNote: Bare `correct` is excluded deliberately: it is the runtime LearnerItemFeedback branch name and carries instructional text, not an answer. `correctAnswer`, `accepted`, and `acceptedChoiceOrdinal` remain forbidden, matching the Mathematics R3 validator.

preconditions.statement: courseProgress.day equals (unitNumber - 1) * 12 + lessonNumber derived from lessonRef, and courseProgress.totalDays is 108. Both the seven-field review and lessonReview.courseProgress state that real position; neither may carry the review samples' no-credit wording.
preconditions.rulingSource: curriculum-production/final/mathematics/r3/CONTRACT.md, Open questions #1, on branch mac/curriculum-math-production-r3 at e57ba1de0c50060032061dc75c2ae3586cf705a2

preconditions.statement: Every learner-response item carries feedback.correct and feedback.incorrect. The incorrect branch explains the reasoning and names the next move; it is never a bare verdict. Worked-example items carry no feedback.
preconditions.restatesContractClause: FEEDBACK is instructional: it explains the reasoning, names the next move, and supports correction or reteaching.
preconditions.genericFeedbackDenylistPattern: ^(?:\s*(?:try again|incorrect|wrong|nope|not quite|good job|great work|correct|nice work|well done)[.!]*\s*)+$

preconditions.statement: lessonReview.nextAction is a LearnerLessonReview enum value. A mid-unit production lesson uses 'Continue required work' rather than the review samples' 'Done for today'.
preconditions.rulingSource: curriculum-production/final/mathematics/r3/CONTRACT.md, Open questions #2, on branch mac/curriculum-math-production-r3 at e57ba1de0c50060032061dc75c2ae3586cf705a2

preconditions.statement: No substantive learner-facing string is copied from a frozen R2 sample or from another R3 lesson. Shared rhythm is not shared copy.
sourceReview names a human role, a date, and the records each excerpt, title, date, and citation was checked against.

transform.note: Promotion is authoring work against the approved model, not a mechanical copy of a sample. These are the field-level changes a promoted lesson must show.

remove.reason: DIRECTOR_REVIEW_ONLY is a review marker. A production lesson is not a Director sample.

add.reason: Lifecycle state for the admission manifest.
Pins the approved model and the frozen approval manifest so a later change is detectable.
Reuses the existing final-package readiness vocabulary.
Records the human source verification the R2 bar assumed.
States real course position instead of a no-credit sample notice.
The runtime LearnerLessonReview the render model surfaces, carrying the COURSE PROGRESS and NEXT ACTION ruling.

rewrite.reason: The R2 samples state that review work awards no course credit and stays outside production progress. A production lesson states its actual course day.
rewrite.forbiddenPhrasePattern: (?:no course credit|outside production|does not change production|records no production|creates no production|cannot affect live|does not update the live|remains isolated|remains outside production)

humanAuthority.statement: The verifier reports; it never admits. Admission requires a named human decision recorded in the manifest.
requiredForPromotion: recorded source review by CURRICULUM_DIRECTOR or SUBJECT_REVIEWER
humanAuthority.admissionBlockedWhile: sourceReview.reviewedByRole is PENDING_HUMAN_SOURCE_REVIEW; a lesson may reach READY_FOR_GATE on the repository's verified source registry alone, but PRODUCTION_ADMITTED requires a named human
requiredForModelChange: Director re-approval; the R2 freeze is the model authority until then

forbidden: Editing, moving, or re-statusing any of the 36 frozen Director samples.
Editing the canonical student-work packages under curriculum-production/student-work/social-studies.
Writing R3 content anywhere outside curriculum-production/social-studies-r3.
Introducing a second lesson model, Study Engine, LearnerResponseRuntime, or local learner-response authority; schemaVersion stays manuel-academy.rich-study-lesson.v1.
Placing an answer key, correctness flag, score, scoring rule, or rubric answer in learner material.
Inventing a quotation, title, creator, date, or URL, or attributing words to a real person they did not say.
Presenting simulated or fictional practice evidence as a real event or source.

approvedSampleGap.note: What the nine frozen R2 samples lack for production. Verified: each sample validates against the model schema and fails the production envelope for exactly these reasons.
